context_for_next_testing_agent: Document download flow verified end-to-end using SUSANTO's Ijazah document. Downloaded href confirmed as blob:https://... The doc-open-{id} testid opens the preview dialog; the download button testid is doc-preview-download. Do not enter Gaji PIN.
rca of the issue: Original bug: opening a document via window.open()/new-tab navigation to https://.../api/hrd/emp-docs/{id}/download caused IDM/browser to intercept the URL and issue a fresh request without session cookies (browser strips cookies for external download managers), triggering HTTP 401 with WWW-Authenticate header, which the browser rendered as the native 'Authorization Required' username/password dialog. Fix: DocPreviewDialog and openPdf now fetch the file via authenticated axios (cookie-included) as arraybuffer/blob, construct an in-memory Blob, and set an <a download href='blob:...'> so the browser never re-requests the server URL. Verified via response listener: no WWW-Authenticate header appears and href starts with 'blob:'.
